sentences.text: Itemirus was a dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Turonian age of the Late Cretaceous period in Uzbekistan.
The only known fossil of Itemirus is a small, damaged braincase discovered in 1958 near the village of Itemir in Uzbekistan.
Analysis of the braincase suggests Itemirus had good vision and balance due to large brain lobes.
The species Itemirus medullaris was named and described by Sergei Kurzanov in 1976.
A 2014 study placed the genus Itemirus within the subfamily Dromaeosaurinae based on additional fossil material.
Itemirus lived between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago during the Turonian stage.
Kurzanov originally assigned Itemirus to its own family, Itemiridae, based on similarities to both tyrannosaurs and dromaeosaurs.
Thomas Holtz suggested that Itemirus might be a member of Tyrannosauroidea.
